mapper.sql: select id, group_name, group_code, space_type, owner_user_id, visibility_json, ownership_policy, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from px_data_group
mapper.insert:
insert into px_data_group
group_name, group_code, space_type, owner_user_id, visibility_json, ownership_policy, status, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time,
#{groupName}, #{groupCode}, #{spaceType}, #{ownerUserId}, #{visibilityJson}, #{ownershipPolicy}, #{status}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, #{createTime}, #{updateBy}, #{updateTime},
mapper.select: select user_id from px_data_group_member where group_id = #{groupId} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert:
insert into px_data_group_member(group_id, user_id, role, status, create_time) values
(#{item.groupId}, #{item.userId}, #{item.role}, #{item.status}, #{item.createTime})
mapper.select: select distinct user_id from px_data_group_member where status = 'active' and group_id in ( select m.group_id from px_data_group_member m join px_data_group g on g.id = m.group_id where m.user_id = #{userId} and m.status = 'active' and g.status = '0' ) union select #{userId}

select distinct member.user_id from px_data_group_member member join px_data_group g on g.id = member.group_id where member.status = 'active' and g.status = '0' and member.group_id in ( select mine.group_id from px_data_group_member mine where mine.user_id = #{userId} and mine.status = 'active' ) and (#{module} = '' or JSON_CONTAINS(COALESCE(g.visibility_json, JSON_ARRAY()), JSON_QUOTE(#{module}))) union select #{userId}
select id, group_id, user_id, role, status, left_time, create_time from px_data_group_member where group_id = #{groupId} order by status, role, create_time
mapper.update: update px_data_group_member set status = 'left', left_time = now() where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active' and role != 'owner'
update px_data_group_member set role = #{role} where group_id = #{groupId} and user_id = #{userId} and status = 'active'
mapper.insert: insert into px_space_member_audit(group_id, user_id, action, operator_id, ownership_policy, detail_json, create_time) values(#{groupId}, #{userId}, #{action}, #{operatorId}, #{ownershipPolicy}, #{detailJson}, now())
mapper.select: select count(distinct g.id) from px_data_group g join px_data_group_member requester on requester.group_id = g.id join px_data_group_member owner_member on owner_member.group_id = g.id where g.status = '0' and requester.user_id = #{userId} and requester.status = 'active' and owner_member.user_id = #{ownerId} and owner_member.status = 'active' and JSON_CONTAINS(COALESCE(g.visibility_json, JSON_ARRAY()), JSON_QUOTE(#{module}))
